question: In The Delian Tomb adventure, what happens if a character tries to open one of the sarcophagi or take items from the treasure room?
expected_answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack the party.

vector_naive.answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack. Two triggers: non-oath sword taking OR any character opening sarcophagi/taking items. Treasure: 3d20 gp, circlets 30 gp, tapestry 45 gp. Source: The Delian Tomb p.8.
search_queries: Delian Tomb sarcophagi treasure room opening taking items

vector_2round.answer: Three skeletons emerge. Both trigger conditions. Edict Blade (+1, +2 vs goblinoids). Full treasure. Source: The Delian Tomb p.7-8.

vector_free.answer: Three skeletons emerge. Both triggers. Treasure values listed. Source: The Delian Tomb p.7-8.

quality.notes: Complete with both triggers and treasure.

hybrid_free.answer: Three skeletons emerge. Both trigger conditions. Oath context. Treasure: 3d20 gp, circlets 30 gp, tapestry 45 gp. Source: The Delian Tomb p.7-8.
